title: Everyone Lied About Last Night 🤖 Ep.2

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: 7:40 a.m. The suspect list went up. [beat] And this school… [beat] became a detective movie.

lines.speaker: riku
lines.text: You think it's ME? Bro, I was up all night in ranked matches! [beat] Forty people watched me lose! [beat] FORTY!

lines.speaker: mira
lines.text: Checked. His game log runs till 4 a.m. [beat] Painful… [beat] but true. He's clean.

lines.speaker: ding
lines.text: That's exactly what a guilty person would say! [beat] …No, wait. That clears him. [beat] Moving on.

lines.speaker: mim
lines.text: Okay, FINE. I was at school that night. [beat] But I was painting in the art room. [beat] Alone. [beat] Don't judge my process.

lines.speaker: phupu
lines.text: MIM?! At NIGHT?! [beat] This is bigger than the exam! [beat] I need to call… [beat] absolutely everyone.

lines.speaker: huda
lines.text: Enough. [beat] Mim is banned from that room — she knows why. [beat] The paper is STILL missing.

lines.speaker: joy
lines.text: Guys… the footprints. [beat] They never leave the building. [beat] They end… at the teachers' lounge.

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: The staff room has a SECOND room? [beat] Since WHEN?

lines.speaker: mira
lines.text: Since always. Focus. [beat] The briefcase lock wasn't broken. [beat] It was OPENED. [beat] With a key.

lines.speaker: kamal
lines.text: Only three keys exist. [beat] Mine… the principal's… [beat] and the office spare.

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: Then it's simple! We check the spare hook! [beat] Key there — a thief copied it. [beat] Key gone—

lines.speaker: joy
lines.text: It's gone. [beat] The hook is EMPTY. [beat] But the name tag… [beat] is still hanging there.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Every eye turned to that tag. [beat] And the name written on it… [beat] ended the investigation before it began.

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: Follow for part three — [beat] because the name on that tag… [beat] made NO sense.
